name: grtwo-docs
description: grtwo-docs lets you publish and manage shareable documents directly from Claude. Publish Markdown or HTML as public or restricted grtwo-docs links without leaving the conversation. List your documents, retrieve content by slug, update titles and body text, or delete documents you no longer need. Each publish returns a URL you can share. Connect with OAuth using your grtwo-docs account. Requires a Pro or Pro Plus subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add grtwo-docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add grtwo-docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.grtwo.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the grtwo-docs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: grtwo-docs provides these MCP tools: publish_document, get_document, list_documents, update_document, and delete_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to grtwo-docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to grtwo-docs in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
grtwo-docs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
grtwo-docs is developed by GRTwo Digital LLC. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
